evidence: Matches Wallet label, modifies `src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.h`, and manages secret nonce storage for wallet descriptor MuSig2 signing sessions.
rationale: Prevents potential locked memory exhaustion by bounding pending MuSig2 signing sessions per descriptor to 2048. Without this bound, abandoned multi-input signing flows or batches of large PSBTs could accumulate secret nonces in locked memory indefinitely.
